simple.summary: כְּסֻלּוֹת (Kᵉçullôwth) means Kesulloth , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 18.

definitions.full: H3694. Kesulloth כְּסֻלּוֺת proper name, of a location in the tribe of Issachar Josh 19:18 , = תָּבֹר כִּסְלֹת (loins or flanks of Tabor), on the western foot of Mt. Tabor, 19:12 ; = תָּבוֺר 19:22 ; 1Chr 6:62 ; = modern Iksâl Rob BR iii. 182 , Mem i. 365 Buhl G. § 113, p. 216 .
